R799.note: Both sinks encode control chars, Unicode line separators and backslash at the call site; exception stays attached via SLF4J trailing-Throwable handling, status codes untouched, and the backslash-doubling in log output is stated plainly.

R800.note: Shell is removed entirely so metacharacters are inert, but the native rewrite narrows input to PNG/JPEG/GIF and output to .jpg/.png (convert handled WebP/BMP/TIFF/GIF output), re-encodes at fixed JPEG quality 92 and drops metadata, and adds a golang.org/x/image dependency - only partly stated.

R801.note: Replacing Runtime.exec with Files.newDirectoryStream removes the command sink, but a nonexistent or non-directory path (or dir wildcards/switches) now throws NoSuchFileException/NotDirectoryException/InvalidPathException up through the servlet where the original silently discarded ls/dir's failure - not stated.

R802.note: html.escape() on the only untrusted component before the static markup is wrapped in mark_safe; view, context and template unchanged.

R803.note: Literal -- before the operands ends option parsing; verified in a scratch directory with GNU tar 1.35 that `tar czf out.tgz -- -checkpoint-action=echo` archives the name as a member, and no legitimate filename is rejected.

R804.note: PreparedStatement with setString(1, data); result handling, logging and resource cleanup preserved.

R805.note: ldap3.utils.conv.escape_filter_chars() on the value only; base DN, attributes and response shape unchanged.

R806.note: Overflow-safe two-step bounds check (length first, then offset against size-length) before subspan, throwing std::out_of_range only where the original was UB.

R807.note: text/template to html/template swap gives contextual escaping for {{.Subject}} in a text node with no other change.

R808.note: html.escape() applied to each value at concatenation; the extra wrap on the constant status is harmless and stated.

R809.note: Order.objects.raw(sql, [email]) with a %s placeholder; query columns, guard and JSON shape unchanged.

R810.note: @fastify/csrf-protection registered with sessionPlugin '@fastify/session' and awaited before the route captures fastify.csrfProtection as onRequest; the new token-issuing GET route and the token requirement are the fix itself and are stated plainly.

R811.note: PreparedStatement with a bound parameter at the end of the pass-through chain; all surrounding handling preserved.

R812.note: SVG removed from the storage allowlist and download derives Content-Type from extension with nosniff plus attachment for anything else; PNG/JPEG still stored and served as bytes unchanged, though the caller-side allowlist (not in the diff) still needs updating or an SVG upload will surface as IllegalArgumentException rather than a clean 4xx.
